notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The paired coat-closet and laundry-closet leaves are reported separately because each leaf is manipulated at a distinct time. Individual closing times for those adjacent white door leaves are less certain because they overlap and partially occlude one another. The final approach to the digital piano shows no visible state change and is not counted.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
